title: Battle of Mytilene (1690)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mytilene (1690)", at revision 1370270325, opens: "The Battle of Mytilene was a naval battle that occurred on 8 September 1690 at Mytilene between a Venetian fleet under Daniele Dolfin and a combined Muslim fleet made up of Ottoman and Barbary ships. The battle resulted in a victory for the Venetian naval forces. This defeat inspired Suleiman II to end Ottoman reliance on Barbary pirates." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4677392, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1690 naval battle between a Venetian fleet under Daniele Dolphin and a combined Muslim fleet". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
